# TempoScript

> TempoScript is a free, offline-capable web app that turns a Markdown script into timed speaker notes. The speaker marks each section of the script with a duration (for example `?05:00`), and presentation mode highlights the current section, runs timers and warns when a section goes over its time.

- URL: https://www.temposcript.com/
- Price: free, no account, no paid plan
- Platform: any modern browser on desktop, tablet or phone; installable as a progressive web app; works offline after the first visit
- Privacy: scripts are stored only in the browser's local storage; nothing is uploaded; no tracking
- Source code: https://github.com/mhruiz/TempoScript (MIT license)
- Languages: interface in English; overview page in Spanish

## What it is for

Use TempoScript when you speak against the clock and have no presenter view: conference talks, lectures, thesis defences, pitches, podcasts, live streams, video recording, or slides shown as a PDF or a shared browser tab. It is not a slide tool and not a scrolling teleprompter. It is a script with a time budget per section.

## Time marker syntax

A time marker is a line that starts with question marks. It sets the duration of the text below it, up to the next marker.

| Marker | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `?10:00` | Top-level section that lasts 10 minutes |
| `??03:00` | Sub-section that lasts 3 minutes, inside the section above |
| `???00:30` | Sub-sub-section that lasts 30 seconds |
| `?!!` | Untimed section: elapsed time is shown, there is no limit |
| `??!!` | Untimed sub-section: the parent section's time keeps running |

Rules:

- Each marker goes on its own line.
- Time is `mm:ss` with two digits each; seconds must be a multiple of 5.
- A nested marker has exactly one more `?` than its parent.
- A sub-section cannot be longer than its parent section.
- The planned total is the sum of the timed top-level sections.

Example:

```markdown
?01:00
# Opening
Introduce yourself and state the problem.

?05:00
## Main idea

??02:00
First argument.

??02:30
Second argument.

?!!
## Questions
```

## Presentation mode

- Highlights the current section and dims the rest.
- Timers: total elapsed and planned total, current section, and parent section.
- Progress bar turns red and pulses when a section runs over.
- Optional auto-advance to the next section when time runs out.
- Timers follow the real clock, and the screen is kept awake where the browser allows it.
- Adjustable text size and fullscreen.
- Keyboard: Space or P play/pause; Right arrow or N next; Left arrow or B previous; F fullscreen; + and - text size; H help; Esc exit.

## Files and sharing

- Export the script as a Markdown file; import a Markdown or text file.
- Copy a share link that holds the whole script, compressed, in the URL fragment. The fragment is not sent to the server.
